overview: This file traces U.S. and Allied involvement in Japan’s postwar constitution from 1945 to 1949. Drafts, directives, diplomatic correspondence, and Far Eastern Commission records document disputes over democratic principles, Japanese adoption, public disclosure, implementing laws, and later review of the constitution.
interest: Successive drafts and internal disagreements reveal how Allied officials balanced Japanese self-government against occupation oversight.
